it does not specifically state that both wheat and sunflower oil prices increased."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R06-E018","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Egyptian authorities requested IMF support in March, and after months of negotiations a six-month, US$3 billion program was announced in October;
